punchline: Julia Cameron's cure for creative block is three pages a day that are deliberately not supposed to be good.
thirty_sec: Julia Cameron has blocked artists do one thing every morning: write three pages by hand, whatever's in their head. Petty, boring, repetitive, it doesn't matter. Nobody reads them, not even you at first. The idea is that you're not empty, you're cluttered, and writing fast without editing gets past the inner critic so the real work has room to start.
question: If you wrote three pages of whatever was on your mind tomorrow morning, what do you think would come out first?
